data.name: Saeqah
data.gender_notes: Saeqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Saqqa’, meaning to pour or to provide with water. This name evokes images of a graceful bird, quenching its thirst in a calm, serene lake. The name Saeqah carries the meaning “Bird” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Saeqah usually hope their child will grow to embody bird and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the gentle and nurturing spirit of a mother, providing sustenance and protection to those around her. Symbolizes grace, beauty, and the gentle flow of life.
data.etymology: Saeqah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bird.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saeqah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: سعقة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على السرعة في الإنقاذ أو العون الإلهي
in_arabic.long_meaning: سعقة هو اسم مشتق من الفعل سَعَقَ والذي يعني الإسراع في الإنقاذ أو تقديم العون بسرعة. في سياق إسلامي، يمكن أن يُفسر الاسم على أنه الرزق أو النجدة الإلهية التي تأتي بسرعة للمسلمين. يرتبط الاسم بمعاني السرعة في الاستجابة و الإنقاذ من الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: سعقہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک ایسا نام جو الہی مدد یا سرپرستی کی سرعت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: سعقہ ایک عربی ಮೂಲ کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مدد یا حمایت کی سرعت. اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام الہی عنایت یا مدد کی جلدی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو مسلمانوں کو ملتی ہے. یہ نام اس معیار کو ظاہر کرتا ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں کی مدد کے لیے 얼 جوشی سے کام لیتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: सअक़ा
in_hindi.meaning: एक नाम जो ईश्वरीय मदद या संरक्षण की गति को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: सअक़ा एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मदद या संरक्षण की गति. इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम ईश्वरीय अनुग्रह या मदद की तेजी को दर्शाता है जो मुसलमानों को मिलती है. यह नाम इस मानक को दर्शाता है कि अल्लाह अपने सेवकों की मदद के लिए शीघ्रता से कार्य करता है.

in_pashto.name: سعقه
in_pashto.meaning: د الهي مرستي يا ساتنې د چټکتیا نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: سعقه د عربي اصلي نوم دی چې د مرستي يا ساتنې د چټکتیا معنی لري. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم د الهي فضل يا مرستې چټکتیا څرګندوي چې مسلمانانو ته رسيږي. دا نوم داسې معیار ښيي چې الله تعالی د خپلو بندګانو د مرستې لپاره چټک کار اخلي.

in_english.name: Saeqah
in_english.meaning: Name signifying speed in divine aid or protection
in_english.long_meaning: Saeqah is a name derived from Arabic roots, signifying speed or quickness in divine aid or protection. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the swiftness of Allah's assistance or providence that reaches Muslims. The name reflects the concept that Allah hastens to aid His servants. Etymologically linked to the Arabic verb 'sa'qa', meaning to hasten or rush to aid, Saeqah embodies the spiritual significance of rapid divine intervention and support.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Saeqah" carries a rich cultural significance. It is a name of admiration and longing for the quenching of thirst. In a metaphorical context, this can relate to the desire for knowledge or the aspiration for spiritual growth. During Ramadan, the month of fasting, the idea of hydration is amplified. Saeqah can serve as a reminder of the importance of nourishment and sustenance, not only for physical survival but also for emotional and spiritual fulfillment.
data.spiritual_significance: Saeqah represents the eternal nourishment and quenching of our spiritual thirst. Inspired by the dhikr (remembrance of Allah), this name recalls the essence of faith and reminds us to continually seek spiritual growth. Saeqah's spiritual meaning suggests the eternal satiation of our souls, drawing parallel to the pouring of water from a vessel that fills the contained space but never overflows. Saeqah exhorts us to nurture the faith within us, allowing it to overflow and enrich our lives.
